siteCheckLauncher.description: Label of the small floating button that opens Voyager's site check panel

siteCheckTitle.description: Heading of the panel listing which Voyager selectors match on the current page

siteCheckPrivacy.message: لا يغادر أي شيء هذه الصفحة حتى تنسخ التقرير أو تنزّله أو تفتح بلاغًا. لا يتضمن التقرير نص الرسائل أو العناوين أو بيانات الحساب أو الروابط الكاملة.
siteCheckPrivacy.description: Privacy note at the top of the site check panel

siteCheckSummary.message: تم فحص {checked} من المحددات · {broken} قد تكون معطلة
siteCheckSummary.description: Summary line; {checked} and {broken} are numbers and must stay as written

siteCheckAllFound.message: تم فحص {checked} من المحددات · عُثر على كل ما يُتوقع هنا
siteCheckAllFound.description: Summary line when nothing looks broken; {checked} is a number and must stay as written

siteCheckRerun.description: Button that runs the site check again on the current page

siteCheckPick.description: Button that starts the element picker, which adds one page element's structure to the report

siteCheckPickHint.message: انقر على الجزء الذي يبدو معطلًا في الصفحة. اضغط Esc للإلغاء.
siteCheckPickHint.description: Instruction shown while the element picker is active

siteCheckCancel.description: Button that leaves the element picker without picking

siteCheckSelectors.description: Heading of the table of selectors and their match counts

siteCheckColSource.description: Table column: the site adapter or the plugin that relies on the selector

siteCheckColMatches.description: Table column: how many page elements the selector matches

siteCheckColResult.description: Table column: whether the match count looks right

siteCheckVerdictOk.description: Result: the selector matched at least one element

siteCheckVerdictMissing.description: Result: the selector matched nothing although the element should be on this page; likely broken

siteCheckVerdictNotHere.description: Result: nothing matched, but the element appears only once a conversation is open

siteCheckVerdictNotJudged.description: Result: nothing matched, and Voyager cannot tell whether the element should exist right now

siteCheckVerdictInvalid.description: Result: this browser cannot parse the selector

siteCheckVerdictUnresolved.description: Result: a plugin needs a selector this site does not define

siteCheckPicked.description: Heading of the section about the element the person picked

siteCheckPickedNone.message: اختياري: اختر الجزء الذي يبدو معطلًا في الصفحة لإضافة بنيته (دون نص) إلى التقرير.
siteCheckPickedNone.description: Shown before any element is picked

siteCheckPickedNoMatch.message: لا يطابق أي محدد من Voyager هذا العنصر أو العناصر المحيطة به.
siteCheckPickedNoMatch.description: Shown when the picked element and its ancestors match no selector

siteCheckPreview.description: Expandable section showing the full Markdown report

siteCheckCopy.description: Button that copies the report as Markdown

siteCheckDownload.description: Button that downloads the report as a JSON file

siteCheckOpenIssue.description: Button that copies the report and opens Voyager's GitHub bug report form

siteCheckClose.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the site check panel

siteCheckCopied.description: Toast after the report was copied

siteCheckCopiedForIssue.message: تم نسخ التقرير. ألصقه في خانة Sanitized Diagnostics في نموذج البلاغ.
siteCheckCopiedForIssue.description: Toast after copying the report and opening the issue form

siteCheckCopyFailed.message: تعذّر نسخ التقرير. استخدم «نزّل ملف ‎.json» وأرفق الملف.
siteCheckCopyFailed.description: Toast when the clipboard is unavailable
